ISO7816 Exported Functions

group ISO7816_Exported_Functions

Functions

void ISO7816_DeInit(void)

Deinitialize the ISO7816 peripheral registers to their default reset values(turn off ISO7816 clock).

Example usage 

void driver_smartcard_init(void)
{
   ISO7816_DeInit();
}

void ISO7816_Init(ISO7816_InitTypeDef *ISO7816_InitStruct)

Initialize the ISO7816 peripheral according to the specified parameters in ISO7816_InitStruct.

Example usage 

void driver_smartcard_init(void)
{
    ISO7816_DeInit();

    RCC_PeriphClockCmd(APBPeriph_ISO7816, APBPeriph_ISO7816_CLOCK, ENABLE);

    ISO7816_InitTypeDef ISO7816_InitStruct;
    ISO7816_StructInit(&ISO7816_InitStruct);

    ISO7816_InitStruct.ISO7816_IntegerF              = 372;
    ISO7816_InitStruct.ISO7816_IntegerD              = 1;
    ISO7816_InitStruct.ISO7816_IOMode                = ISO7816_IO_MODE_TX;
    ISO7816_InitStruct.ISO7816_CodingConvention      = ISO7816_CODING_CONVENTION_DIRECT;
    ISO7816_InitStruct.ISO7816_IOStateSample         = ISO7816_IO_STATE_SAMPLE_ENABLE;
    //Add other initialization parameters that need to be configured here.
    ISO7816_Init(ISO7816, &ISO7816_InitStruct);
}

参数:

ISO7816_InitStruct -- [in] Pointer to a ISO7816_InitTypeDef structure which will be initialized.

void ISO7816_StructInit(ISO7816_InitTypeDef *ISO7816_InitStruct)

Fill each ISO7816_InitStruct member with its default value.

Example usage 

void driver_smartcard_init(void)
{
    ISO7816_DeInit();

    RCC_PeriphClockCmd(APBPeriph_ISO7816, APBPeriph_ISO7816_CLOCK, ENABLE);

    ISO7816_InitStruct.ISO7816_IntegerF              = 372;
    ISO7816_InitStruct.ISO7816_IntegerD              = 1;
    ISO7816_InitStruct.ISO7816_IOMode                = ISO7816_IO_MODE_TX;
    ISO7816_InitStruct.ISO7816_CodingConvention      = ISO7816_CODING_CONVENTION_DIRECT;
    ISO7816_InitStruct.ISO7816_IOStateSample         = ISO7816_IO_STATE_SAMPLE_ENABLE;
    //Add other initialization parameters that need to be configured here.
    ISO7816_Init(ISO7816, &ISO7816_InitStruct);
}

备注

The default settings for the ISO7816_InitStruct member are shown in the following table:

ISO7816_InitStruct member

Default value

ISO7816_IntegerF

372

ISO7816_IntegerD

1

ISO7816_IOMode

ISO7816_IO_MODE_TX

ISO7816_CodingConvention

ISO7816_CODING_CONVENTION_DIRECT

ISO7816_IOStateSample

ISO7816_IO_STATE_SAMPLE_ENABLE

参数:

ISO7816_InitStruct -- [in] Pointer to an ISO7816_InitTypeDef structure which will be initialized.

void ISO7816_INTConfig(uint32_t ISO7816_INT, FunctionalState NewState)

Enable or disable the specified ISO7816 interrupts.

Example usage 

void smartcard_demo(void)
{
    ISO7816_INTConfig(ISO7816_INT_TX_DONE, ENABLE);
}

参数:

  • ISO7816_INT -- [in] Specify the ISO7816 interrupt sources. This parameter can refer to ISO7816 Interrupts Definition.

  • NewState -- [in] New state of the specified ISO7816 interrupt source. This parameter can be one of the following values:

    • ENABLE: Enable the ISO7816 interrupt.

    • DISABLE: Disable the ISO7816 interrupt.

void ISO7816_DelayCycle(uint32_t cycle)

This function aims to provide delay based on cycle count Which should be count/Freq (s), given unit of Freq is Hz. Yet the actual delay function takes input parameters with unit us. We should have called simc_delay_us(count * 10^6 / Freq). However, there would be possible integer overflow of (count * 10^6). Thus we call iso7816_delay_us((count * 10^3) / (Freq / 10^3)) instead.

Example usage 

void smartcard_demo(void)
{
    ISO7816_DelayCycle(2000);
}

参数:

cycle -- [in] ISO7816 cycle count.

FlagStatus ISO7816_GetFlagStatus(uint32_t ISO7816_FLAG)

Check whether the specified SmartCard flag is set.

Example usage 

void smartcard_demo(void)
{
    while (ISO7816_GetFlagStatus(ISO7816x, ISO7816_FLAG_TX_FIFO_EMPTY) == 0);
    ISO7816_SendData(data, sizeof(data));
}

参数:

ISO7816_FLAG -- [in] Specify ISO7816 flag to check. This parameter can be one of the following values:

  • ISO7816_FLAG_RX_DATA_AVA: Rx data is avaliable.

  • ISO7816_FLAG_RX_OVERRUN: Rx FIFO overrun.

  • ISO7816_FLAG_RX_PARITY_ERR: Rx parity error.

  • ISO7816_FLAG_RX_FRAME_ERR: Rx frame error.

  • ISO7816_FLAG_RX_BREAK_ERR: Rx break error.

  • ISO7816_FLAG_TX_FIFO_EMPTY: Tx Holding Register or Tx FIFO empty

  • ISO7816_FLAG_TX_EMPTY: Tx FIFO and Tx shift register are both empty.

  • ISO7816_FLAG_RX_FIFO_ERR: Rx FIFO error.

  • ISO7816_FLAG_RX_BREAK: Rx break.

  • ISO7816_FLAG_RX_IDLE: Rx idle.

  • ISO7816_FLAG_TX_DONE: Tx waveform done & TX_FIFO_EMPTY = 1.

  • ISO7816_FLAG_TX_THD: TX_FIFO_LEVEL<=txfifo_trigger_level.

返回:

New status of ISO7816 flag.

  • SET: The specified ISO7816 flag bit is set.

  • RESET: The specified flag is not set.

uint16_t ISO7816_GetINTStatus(void)

Get the specified ISO7816 interrupt status.

参数:

ISO7816_INT -- [in] Specify the interrupt source to check. This parameter can be one of the following values. Refer to ISO7816 Interrupts Definition.

  • ISO7816_INT_RESET_TIMING_VIOLATION: Reset timing violation.

  • ISO7816_INT_TX_NAK_THD: TNAKTH exceeded.

  • ISO7816_INT_RX_WAIT_TIMEOUT: Character wait timeout.

  • ISO7816_INT_GP_COUNTER: General purpose counter hit.

  • ISO7816_INT_TX_FIFO_EMPTY: TX FIFO empty.

  • ISO7816_INT_TX_FIFO_NOT_FULL: TX FIFO not full, triggered when TX FIFO changes from full to non-full.

  • ISO7816_INT_TX_FIFO_OVERFLOW: TX FIFO overflow.

  • ISO7816_INT_RX_FIFO_NOT_EMPTY: RX FIFO not empty, triggered when RX FIFO changes from empty to non-empty.

  • ISO7816_INT_RX_FIFO_ALMOST_FULL: RX FIFO almost full

  • ISO7816_INT_RX_FIFO_FULL: RX FIFO full.

  • ISO7816_INT_RX_FIFO_OVERFLOW: RX FIFO overflow.

  • ISO7816_INT_RX_FIFO_UNDERFLOW: RX FIFO underflow.

  • ISO7816_INT_TX_DONE: Transmission completed, triggered when TX FIFO is empty and the last bit has been sent out.

返回:

The new state of ISO7816 interrupts.

  • SET: The specified interrupt status is set.

  • RESET: The specified interrupt status is not set.
